    JlatexmathResources
    Where JLaTeXMath finds its resources (the XML files of the font metrics, the symbols and the macros, and the glyph outlines of glyphs.bin) in the C build, which has no class loader: in the files embedded in the executable, under "jlatexmath/" (copied by Gradle from src/main/resources/org/scilab/forge/jlatexmath, see copyNativeSources).

    JlatexmathResourcesJs
    Where JLaTeXMath finds its resources (the XML files and the glyph outlines) in the browser build, which has no class loader: in the global PLANTUML_JLATEXMATH, a map from the path of the resource (under org/scilab/forge/jlatexmath/) to its content in Base64.
